top_choice_rationale: The magic-wavelength lattice is a single, general mechanism (cancelled differential light shift, Doppler- and recoil-free interrogation of many atoms) that is cleanly stated and has been reproduced in independent laboratories with Sr, Yb and Hg at the 1e-18 level, so the physics is understood and not merely engineered. Katori (proposal and first realization) and Ye (record accuracy and many-body understanding) have separable roles, and the citation scope on the lattice invention keeps it distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. This is a mature, verified achievement and is preferred to making no award, although the overlap with earlier metrology prizes and the omitted contributors remain real reservations.
